# AI-02: Prompt Engineering and Structured Generation (Tier 3)

**Subtrack:** AI Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Prompt design as specification, few-shot design, schema-constrained output, prompt testing and regression.

**Tier note:** Tier 3 has one assessment. Advanced prompt work quickly becomes evaluation (AI-10), context engineering (AI-08) or adaptation (AI-12), so a single research-grade prompt-optimisation study is enough here.

A Regression Gate for Prompts in a Multilingual Care Bot.** Design and implement a statistically defensible regression gate for prompt changes in a multilingual care bot, measure its false-block and detection rates by simulation against a prompt-sensitive mock, and argue what the protocol can and cannot establish.
